newsitem.title: TURKEY: Boeing to discuss production in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Boeing to discuss production in Turkey.

text.p: A delegation from aircraft manufacturer Boeing met Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan on Monday for talks on possible production in Turkey.

"Turkey needs planes and we put importance on offset agreements. Other firms want to manufacture 50 percent of the product in Turkey but Boeing has brought a proposal for 100 percent," Erbakan told reporters before the meeting.
Boeing officials confirmed production would be discussed.

Erbakan said earlier this year that Turkey was planning to buy 50 civilian aircraft worth a total of $4 billion in an offset agreement under which Turkey would manufacture some of the parts for the planes.
Turkey is also assessing proposals from McDonnell Douglas Corp, Airbus Industrie and Lockheed Martin Corp.
